user.title: Rehau NEA SMART 2.0 (SYSBUS)
user.description: Home Assistant acts as the REHAU KNX gateway (Modbus slave 240/241). Configure the RS485-to-TCP converter as TCP client to this Home Assistant and the port below (38400 baud, 8N1).

data.restore_globals: Re-send last global mode/state after a restart

data_description.zones: Detected zones are pre-filled with generic names; rename them here or later in the device page.
data_description.restore_globals: The base rarely republishes the global mode/state. Enable only if Home Assistant is the only place where you change them: otherwise a change made in the REHAU app while Home Assistant was down would be undone.

progress.discover: Listening on port {port} for the REHAU base (up to 90 s). The converter may take a few seconds to reconnect.

error.invalid_zones: Invalid zones. Use base.zone:name, e.g. 1.5:Living room
